description: Phase 1 will consist of 41 to 62 WTGs with a total generating capacity of up to 804 MW.
context_quote: Phase 1 would have a total generating capacity of up to 804 MW and consist of 41 to 62 Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs).

description: Phase 1 may include up to 2 ESPs.
context_quote: Phase 1 would consist of 41 to 62 Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) and 2 Electrical Service Platforms (ESPs).

description: Phase 2 will consist of up to 88 WTGs with a total generating capacity of at least 1,232 MW.
context_quote: Phase 2 would deliver at least 1,232 MW of power and consist of up to 88 WTGs.

description: Phase 2 may include up to 3 ESPs.
context_quote: Phase 2 would consist of up to 88 WTGs and 3 ESPs.

description: A maximum of 5 offshore export cables will be installed.
context_quote: Five offshore electrical transmission cables, including two for Phase 1 and three for Phase 2, would be installed in an offshore export cable corridor (OECC).

description: Landing sites for Phase 1 cables will be in Barnstable County, Massachusetts.
context_quote: Landing sites for Phase 1 cables would be in Barnstable County, Massachusetts.

description: Intended landing sites for Phase 2 cables will also be in Barnstable County, with a possibility of a site in Bristol County.
geographic_scope: Barnstable County and Bristol County, Massachusetts
context_quote: Intended landing sites for Phase 2 cables would also be in Barnstable County, with the possibility of a landing site in Bristol County as well.

description: The Lessee must submit a modified plan addressing any inconsistencies with the NMFS BiOp within 30 days of receipt of comments.
context_quote: If BOEM and BSEE inform the Lessee the plan is inconsistent with the ITS and NMFS BiOp, the Lessee must submit a modified plan that addresses the identified issues within 30 days of the receipt of the comments.
